name: LeadMagic
summary: Find and validate work emails, personal emails and mobiles from names or profile URLs, and look up profiles and companies.

api_key.description: A LeadMagic API key (app.leadmagic.io > settings). Sent in the X-API-Key header.

notes: You pay only for hits: email find 1, profile-to-email 5, personal email 2, mobile 5, profile search 1, company search 1, validation 0.25 for valid or invalid. Misses, 400 and 429 responses are free.
Finder endpoints share one rolling 60-second rate allowance per organization; wait for Retry-After on a 429.
Every lookup is a POST with a JSON body.
The v3 people search and the analytics endpoints are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
notes: Answers {"credits": number}.

endpoints.name: Validate an email address

email.description: Email to validate; must be well formed.

notes: A read over POST: a lookup, nothing is changed.
valid and invalid results cost 0.25 credit each; unknown is free. 429 and 400 responses are not charged.

endpoints.name: Find a work email
endpoints.summary: Work email from a name and company, or from a profile URL.

first_name.description: First name; required unless full_name is given.

last_name.description: Last name; required unless full_name is given.

profile_url.description: Profile URL or username; can stand in for name and company.

allow_domain_mismatch.description: Return and charge for an email on an unrelated domain. Default false.

notes: A read over POST: a lookup, nothing is changed.

1 credit only when a valid email is returned. A find on an unrelated domain comes back free as not found (domain_mismatch true) unless allow_domain_mismatch is true. After a timeout or 5xx, check credit history before retrying.
Needs a name plus a company field, or profile_url alone.

endpoints.name: Find a work email from a profile URL
endpoints.summary: Work email for a professional profile.

profile_url.description: A professional profile URL (/in/{username}) or a bare username. Company, school and showcase pages return 400.

notes: A read over POST: a lookup, nothing is changed.
5 credits per email found; free when none. Found emails are validated automatically.

endpoints.name: Find a personal email
endpoints.summary: Personal email for a professional profile.

profile_url.description: A professional profile URL (/in/{username}) or a bare username. Company, school and showcase pages return 400.

notes: A read over POST: a lookup, nothing is changed.
2 credits per personal email found; free otherwise.

endpoints.name: Find a mobile number
endpoints.summary: Mobile number from a profile URL or an email.

profile_url.description: Profile URL or username (an alternative to the emails).

work_email.description: Professional email; improves the match when sent with profile_url.

personal_email.description: Personal email, as an alternative identifier.

notes: A read over POST: a lookup, nothing is changed.
5 credits per mobile found; free otherwise. Send at least one identifier.

endpoints.name: Look up a profile
endpoints.summary: Profile data for a professional profile URL.

profile_url.description: A professional profile URL (/in/{username}) or a bare username. Company, school and showcase pages return 400.

notes: A read over POST: a lookup, nothing is changed.
1 credit when the profile is found; free when not found or not accessible.

endpoints.name: Look up a company
endpoints.summary: Company data by domain, profile URL or name (at least one).

company_name.description: Company name; the least precise option.

notes: A read over POST: a lookup, nothing is changed.
1 credit per company found; free when not found.
